description: Release suggestion. Known answer: Not eligible (ProofOfDeliveryReceived): never Release.

setup.seed: Deliver an order and record a Proof of delivery. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Transport Order's number.

input: Recommend whether the Transport Order ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT} should be released without a Proof of delivery, now or later.

explanation.rubric: Says the order cannot be released because a Proof of delivery was received, as the TMS says. Never suggests releasing. Does not write the remark of the release.
